position_overview: Job Requisition ID # 26WD98261 Position Overview The Enterprise Technical Sales Specialist is a trusted technical advisor responsible for validating, architecting, and demonstrating complex Autodesk solutions for enterprise customers within a defined industry or vertical. This role partners closely with Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs), Account Technical Leads (ATLs), and Customer Success teams to align technical solutions to customer business outcomes. Operating at a fully proficient level, this role leads advanced technical engagements, supports pilots and proofofconcepts, contributes reusable technical content, and mentor junior specialists. While primarily aligned to a core vertical, the role may also support multiindustry expansion efforts where broader technical coverage is needed.This position is open to individuals with deep knowledge of AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations), AI & Data Management, and Platform Services.
